reference: Since he was 18: Stanley says in a talking head he has tried to get on jury duty every single year since he was 18, in Classy Christmas (S7E11), after Toby gets jury duty.

evidence.line: Stanley: I have been trying to get on jury duty every single year since I was 18 years old. To get to go sit in an air-conditioned room downtown, judging people while my lunch is paid for... that is the life.
Stanley: So do they bring in food, or do you get to go out? / Toby: No, they bring it in. / Stanley: You lucky son of a bitch.

question: Since what age has Stanley been trying to get jury duty?
